description: Scrape the Trustpilot reviews of any company (rating, title, text, dates, language, reviewer country, verification, company reply, company TrustScore) from a domain or Trustpilot URL, past the 200-review listing cap, with filters by stars, language and date, and a cheap incremental sync with publishedAfter. Compares the Sherwood Trustpilot Reviews Scraper on Apify, memo23/trustpilot-scraper-ppe and Trustpilot's official Business API, and picks one from whose reviews they are and how many. Use when the user says "trustpilot scraper", "scrape Trustpilot reviews of <company>", "export all Trustpilot reviews to CSV", "1 and 2 star Trustpilot reviews of my competitor", "monitor Trustpilot reviews every week", "how many Trustpilot reviews does <domain> have", "Trustpilot reviews dataset without reviewer names". Out of scope: consumer profiles, product reviews, location pages, pending or hidden reviews, posting replies.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
